checks: The default panel shows current-note tags and a searchable library list, with adding/help collapsed; selecting a tag stays in the panel, opens original notes and retains file-search navigation
Adding validates one label, accepts a leading hash, prevents duplicate labels and marks only the draft; saving persists through the existing text writer and refreshes both counts and selected results
Overview and query failures stay local with folded technical details and retry, preserve the editor and cached tag list; stale tag replies cannot replace a newer selection
Read-only notes cannot be tagged; no open note and non-Markdown files have short guidance while the saved tag library remains usable
Six existing styles at desktop and narrow widths retain the home, add form and results without horizontal overflow
scope: Real App/LibraryMode/InlineTagsPanel and Vditor; isolated native IPC responses. Native tag counting is also checked separately on the filesystem.
